notes: Live Worker registrations, availability, ownership and occupancy are persisted atomically in the dedicated Git-ref queue ledger.
Static workers remains empty by design: ephemeral GitHub Actions runners enroll at job start and go offline at job completion.
Worker identity is bound to lane and GitHub Actions run ID; stale owners are fenced by attempt number.
Dependency checks run before each claim; only completed prerequisite lanes satisfy the DAG.
Do not add credentials or tokens to this file.
Workers have no main-branch write, auto-merge, physical-device or Flash-write permissions.
